The Earnest Money Deposit will be refunded to the unsuccessful Vendors. The Earnest money paid by the succ essful Vendors will be kept as security deposit and will be released only after completion of allotte d work. 5) SELECTION PROCESS: Offers will be evaluated in the following stages: Stage I Offers will be evaluated against the stipulated minimum Eligibility Criteria of techni cal bid. Stage II The price bids of only short listed vendors will be opened in GeM portal. 6) WARRANTY The unit rate quoted by the bidder should include atleast 3 years Onsite Comprehensive Warranty for UPS and atleast 2 years Onsite Comprehensive Warranty for Batteries from the date of installa tion.
